result.rationale: CHIL2 is the 725 South Wells facility, not a separate manager-level PortCo. CIM said it sold the four-asset portfolio on 2021-11-02 to a Harrison Street Real Estate Capital/1547 JV; 1547 was already CIM's JV partner and stayed manager. Nothing reviewed shows Harrison bought the 1547 company. Retire task 276 as standalone and link it beneath a correctly bounded task 273 portfolio/JV record; do not merge the legal entities.
